card.name: Time units completing dosing frequency phrases
card.fires_on: The time word that finishes a frequency phrase, such as hours, weeks, daily or weekly after 'every 8 to 12', 'three times' or 'every 4'. Also fires weakly on a few similar completions like 'presenting manifestation'.

modes.label: Frequency unit
modes.description: A time unit or adverb that ends a dosing-interval phrase.

modes.description: The unit hours after a numeric range in a dosing table.
